name: 07-sql
teaches: sql/exec and sql/query against a granted directory in which the program names its database, and the two refusals that come with the split: exec needs access = "readwrite", and a writing statement asked of query is refused by SQLite's own classification.
cmd: echo '$ drt run --config readwrite.json'; drt run --config readwrite.json; echo; echo '$ drt run --config read-only.json'; drt run --config read-only.json
